subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this status-only Wear OS companion as an official Android product surface now, with the Android team owning its module, protocol, CI, and eventual release lifecycle?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but adding a new official native application and permanent CI/release surface is a product and ownership commitment that contributor proof cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the status slice
options.body: Approve the phone-first, credential-free status companion after the version-code and current-head validation requirements are satisfied.

options.title: Keep Wear deferred
options.body: Close or pause the PR until Android maintainers are ready to own Wear packaging, release, support, and CI lifecycle.

options.title: Request a different boundary
options.body: Retain the concept but ask for a maintainer-defined module, distribution, or protocol boundary before further implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the status slice
recommendation.body: Approve the phone-first, credential-free status companion after the version-code and current-head validation requirements are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository names @obviyus as the Android maintainer and the prior Wear proposal was routed to them.
